faq_heading: Mountain View Homes for Sale in Abbotsford: your questions answered

faq.q: Where are the mountain views in Abbotsford?
faq.a: On and around Sumas Mountain, and on the higher ground in Abbotsford East and West. The search above shows listings currently flagged with a mountain view.

faq.q: Is Sumas Prairie a flood risk?
faq.a: Sumas Prairie is the bed of the drained Sumas Lake and part of the Fraser River floodplain, so ask for flood and drainage information on any home there.

blocks.text: This search shows Abbotsford homes whose MLS® view field says Mountain View, live from the MLS®, with land and income properties left out. Abbotsford has a mountain in the middle of its eastern side, Sumas Mountain, and a flat prairie to its south, so the outlook depends heavily on which side of that line a home is on.
Sumas Mountain and the land around it

Sumas Mountain lies between Abbotsford and Chilliwack, on the south bank of the Fraser River. Urban Abbotsford is to its west, and the historic community of Straiton is in the central part of the mountain. The board's Sumas Mountain sub-area is on the mountain itself, and Abbotsford East and West are listed beside it in the table below.

items.t: Sumas Mountain Provincial Park covers the northern part of the mountain, and the eastern reaches are mostly wilderness overlooking Greendale in Chilliwack.
Farming, gravel mining and logging continue on parts of the mountain, and brick-clay mining once gave rise to Clayburn.
Sumas Prairie to the south is the bed of the drained Sumas Lake and forms part of the Fraser River floodplain.
The mountain shields McDonald Park, a dark-sky preserve, from city light.

blocks.text: On SnapStats' October 2026 count, Sumas Mountain had 3 detached homes for sale and 1 sold, a sales ratio of 33%, which reads as a seller's market.
The closed-sales export has no view field, so these medians describe each sub-area as a whole. A mountain-view home is best priced against recent sales close by with a similar outlook.
What to check on an Abbotsford mountain view
The mountain itself is working land as well as scenery, which shapes what to check.

items.t: On Sumas Mountain, ask about nearby gravel, logging or farming activity and how it affects noise and truck traffic.
For Sumas Prairie homes, ask for flood history and floodplain information, since the land is the former lake bed.
Check the water supply and septic arrangement on rural and mountain lots, and ask who maintains the road.
Look at the view at different times of day and in different weather before you decide how much it is worth.
